notes.title: Deck the Halls with Cards and Swords: Winter Sale Adventure Awaits! ❄️
notes.content:
[h2]🗡️ Brave Adventurers! [/h2]

You might be thinking [i]'Another sale announcement? Really?'[/i] And yes, yes it is! Like that one friend who keeps casting Persistence spells, we're STILL here with our magical 70% discount, now part of the [b]Steam Winter Sale![/b]

Whether you're seeking shelter from the cold or gathering around the tavern fire with friends, there's no better time to embark on your card-slinging journey. Build your deck, sharpen your blade, and write your own winter tale!

And hey, while we can't promise this is the last time you'll see a discount (our deals are as persistent as a determined bard), we CAN promise you an adventure worth every coin!  🎮 ❄️

notes.title: Aces & Adventures is joining Regency Solitaire II in the Royal Flush bundle!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello Adventurers! [/b][/h3]

We are excited to announce we have partnered with our friends at Grey Alien Games to bring you all the Royal Flush Bundle! Featuring both Regency Solitaire II and Aces & Adventures with a 10% discount when you complete the set!

You can check out the bundle here!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/38931/

If you are unfamiliar with either title, here is a short summary: 

[h3][b]Regency Solitaire II[/b][/h3]
Revisit romantic Regency Britain and build a glorious garden, in this charming solitaire sequel. Brought to you by the creators of the hit casual card game, Regency Solitaire.
Resolve a tangled web of family secrets to help Bella silence the gossips, and host the season’s most anticipated soiree.
Unlock gameplay features with your makeover project, and reveal bonus 'Collector's Edition' levels and a love story. Don't miss the party everyone's talking about!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2137470/Regency_Solitaire_II/

[h3][b]Aces & Adventures[/b][/h3]
This poker-powered deckbuilding adventure is set in a soaring world drawn from the pages of ancient Norse and Middle Eastern mythology.
You’ll craft a deck and choose how to use your resources – do you aim to defeat your opponents through attacks and spells, or play cards in order to potentially draw devastating high-value poker hands and obliterate your foes in a mighty blow?
Use strategy to combine buffs, debuffs, abilities and spells to unleash combination attacks of catastrophic power.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1815570/Aces__Adventures/

notes.title: Aces & Adventurers Challenge mode update now live - with 30% discount
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers,

[h3][b]Check out the new Challenge Mode for Aces & Adventures now! - And new players can pick it up with a 30% discount[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42466960/a7cbe9ee6908f82576bc77f520a4de55beafeb69.jpg[/img]

[b]We are excited to announce the Challenge Mode update is now live![/b] - The challenge mode contains 3 adventures designed for shorter but challenging runs. You can either take on a version of the War of the Branches, Invernal Spiral or the new Gauntlet mode. 
Gauntlet is a short, but brutal, procedural challenge mode meant to be completed in 15 minutes or less. All adventures will have their random seed locked based on the day and have a corresponding daily modifier associated with them. 

Compete against other players on the new Daily Leader Boards! The fastest successful run wins! 

The Daily Challenge mode is unlocked by either completing the story campaign, or completing Fall difficulty in one of the non-story modes.

We have also added new abilities for the Mage and Enchantress, added the capacity to view abilities in an ability deck at the adventure table by right clicking it, And added the capacity to click the enemy’s draw pile to view cards left in it.

You will also find a variety of bug fixes across the board! If you are a seasoned veteran to Aces & Adventures or looking to pick it up, there has never been a better time! And join us on Discord to share your feedback and compete for bragging rights for topping the daily leader board!

[url=https://discord.gg/JFNSwsRGpA]DISCORD[/url]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.21
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added new game mode: Daily Challenges. Contains 3 adventures: A shortened version of War of the Branches and Invernal Spiral, and a new adventure: Gauntlet. Gauntlet is a short, but brutal, procedural challenge mode meant to be completed in 15 minutes or less. All adventures will have their random seed locked based on the day and have a corresponding daily modifier associated with them. Compete against other players on the new Daily Leaderboards! The Daily Challenge mode is unlocked by either completing the story campaign, or completing Fall difficulty in one of the non-story modes.
[*] Added new abilities for Mage and Enchantress.
[/list]
[list]
[*] You can now view abilities in an ability deck at the adventure table by right clicking it.
[*] You can now click the enemy’s draw pile to view cards left in it (sorted by value).
[/list]
[list]
[*] Fixed a rare bug which could cause progress of an adventure to fail to save correctly.
[*] Fixed bug which could cause Health gained via a full rest to not be accounted for correctly when Health was adjusted by another event.
[*] Fixed bug which had ability tag text spilling out of card bounds for certain languages.
[*] Fixed bug which could occur when you had the Mirage trait and your hand contained only Jokers and Aces. (Previously failed to correctly wild into a full house)
[*] All character abilities which require a top deck in order to be able to use now correctly handle the case where 0 cards remain in your draw & discard piles.
[*] Fixed bug which could cause certain applied abilities which required top decks to fail to apply if 0 cards were in your draw/discard pile at the time of application.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.11
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added Invernal difficulty level for War of the Branches and Invernal Spiral game modes.
[*] Added several new enemies and items to procedural modes.
[*] Added a new node type to Invernal Spiral which allows you to add up to 5 abilities to your deck.
[*] Improved deck editor search functionality for when keywords like “summon” were searched to not fully exclude non-summon abilities that had interactions around summons.
[*] HP, Shield, and Attack additional abilities costs are now searchable in deck editor search text.
[*] Added a new “Safe Mode” launch option which can be accessed by holding F8 when you first see the Splash Screen. This will launch into the game with minimal graphical settings.
[*] Added a “Finish” button for Experience Vial / Ability Pack steps that will show up when the “Quick Mana Vial” option is enabled. Clicking the button will skip the display of all remaining vials and ability packs, but you will still receive them.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Optimized performance of several special effects.
[*] All debuffs should now correctly be affected by Resist and Nullify traits.
[*] Mage’s Omega Sigil should now work correctly on abilities which deal damage multiple times.
[*] Fixed bug which had enemy name’s overflowing out of their card slot in certain languages.
[*] Fixed bugged interaction between Mage’s Cyclone buff and Blade Storm abilities.
[*] Fixed bug which would incorrectly clear offset of enemy’s combat hand cards when mousing over an ability which targeted them.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Dual Wield +2 now removes Guard traits from the defender on successful attack.
[*] Shadow Emissary now also taps the enemy when you successfully defend with a Club, but no longer deals +1 damage if your attack hand contains a Club.
[*] Mage’s Inevitable abilities can no longer be resisted.
[*] Mage’s Flame Blade abilities now have combat damage also reduce Max HP instead of preventing healing. (Same goes for Rogue’s Acid Edge abilities)
[*] Hunter’s Repeater trait now also grants Safe Attack.
[/list]

notes.title: Aces & Adventures Invernal Spiral Update out now! - with 25% discount!
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers, 

We're very happy to announce a brand new way to play Aces & Adventures: The Invernal Spiral, a deck-manager mode inspired by games like Slay the Spire that allows you to build and curate your deck throughout a lengthier adventure.

[previewyoutube=pZcQZtrfPXU;full][/previewyoutube]

You can pick up Aces & Adventures with a fantastic 25% discount! Not only that but you can also buy the Yogscast Games Adventure Bundle complete with both Aces & Adventures and newly released Beyond the Long Night for a further discount! You can find this bundle and more on the Yogscast Games Spring Sale page! 

https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/yogscastgames/sale/yogscastspringsale


Along with this new mode, you'll find a treasure trove of new items, enemies, bosses, abilities, and quality of life improvements! The "War of the Branches" has also seen some improvements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42466960/659342305097df6133f926fd421c2f206b8471ba.gif[/img]

As usual there are four levels of difficulty for you to overcome, with Winter in the Invernal Spiral perhaps being the most grueling challenge yet!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42466960/c916216f32ed3e16dd5ba0b7379d25ea84c65939.png[/img]

But we're not done! You can expect more abilities, enemies, and items to be added in the near future, as well as a new season of the most devious difficulty yet!
And this is all thanks to your support and enthusiasm for the game! Let us know what else you'd like to see, and keep an eye out for more updates to come.

notes.title: Aces & Adventures - Roadmap Reveal!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42466960/20dd45e8b192a7deec726ecbd3769fbaa433bce5.png[/img]

[h3][b]Hello Adventurers! [/b][/h3]

In our latest announcement we said we had some exciting news we were going to share. Well today is that day! Firstly we would like to thank everyone who has purchased and played the game, and to everyone who has reviewed the game on Steam. With over 90% positive reviews, we could not be happier with the reception to Aces & Adventures!

While we're still working on bug fixes and quality of life improvements, we're also working on a whole host of new content, the details of which we are now ready to share with you! From new enemies, events, abilities and QoL updates all the way through to new game modes and daily challenges. 

[h2][b]Aces and Adventures – Road Map [/b][/h2]

[b][h3]New Abilities and Balance[/h3][/b] You can expect to see a steady supply of new abilities for all 5 classes, unlocking new powers and potential builds! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42466960/d632d56d647873654d1f683ff730065ced0f0504.png[/img]

[b][h3]New Items, Enemies, and Events[/h3][/b] We'll keep the War of the Branches and future procedural modes fresh with new content. 

[b][h3]Deck Manager Mode [/h3][/b] Begin with a simple, default deck of about 10 cards, and curate your deck as you embark on a long-form procedural adventure. You can add new abilities, upgrade existing abilities, and prune your deck as you see fit. No two runs will be the same. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42466960/27fea18ae15e88bcc855e5f8a5196cdc919b45ed.png[/img]

[b][h3]Daily Challenges[/h3][/b] Face powerful mutators – like a deck of only Spades or redrawing your ability hand each round – within a fixed, randomly-generated adventure. The adventure will remain the same during the daily challenge, only to change again when the next challenge goes live. 

[b][h3]Quality of Life Improvements[/h3][/b] We're committed to addressing as many of your requests as we can to provide you with as much information and the most intuitive controls possible. Here are some QoL improvements you can expect soon: 
[list]
[*] View all abilities in your deck by clicking on your ability draw pile. Abilities are sorted alphabetically while being viewed. 
[*] View all cards in any discard pile by clicking on it. 
[*] Show potential combat damage numbers on pointer over of suggested and custom attacks. 
[*] Video option to set MSAA separate from Quality Preset. 
[*] Time-to-next-rank tooltip for adventure decks to help clarify the completion ranking system. 
[/list]
Some other features that we have planned but are not yet under development include:
[list]
[*] Ability to view unlocked Level Up traits for a character in the Deck Editor. 
[*] Show starting Level Up traits for a character in the Level Up scenes card pile. 
[*] Ability to view abilities you have not unlocked in Deck Editor. 
[*] Add a small button to access menu with the mouse (no keyboard required). 

[*] [h3][b]Handcrafted Challenges[/b][/h3]  Take on unique challenges presented by custom-made adventures. These are designed to favor new decks and strategies. Some will be epic, long-form adventures, containing a bit of randomness; while others will remain tightly focused gauntlets meant to test your strategic creativity. 

[*] [h3][b]Share Decks[/b][/h3]  Post and share your own custom decks with other players via the Steam Workshop. Other players will be able to use your deck immediately if they have the cards; otherwise, they will be allowed to pay a “mana” (experience) cost equivalent to the number of cards they’re missing to unlock the deck. 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42466960/08eaceb36fb295b65fec39eb6884ecaddc94e612.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.015
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed bugs which would occur when you removed almost every card from your deck via Card Shrines and Events in War of the Branches mode.
[*] Fixed bug which occurred when 2 enemies had Conduit +1 applied on them which caused damage to infinitely loop back and forth between them.
[*] Fixed bug which prevented canceling Night Market Bolt abilities after entering the targeting phase.
[*] Fixed bug which had pause menu render outside of screen bounds when beyond ultra wide aspect ratio.
[*] Fixed bug which had abilities received from ability packs affected by certain buffs causing them to display altered information.
[*] Fixed bug which made Full Bloom achievement require restarting the game to properly unlock.
[*] Fixed a few ability typos and Updated Localization.
[/list]
[list]
[*] The cards actually being used for enemy attacks and defenses are now nudged forward in the enemy's hand to improve clarity.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Added “Minimum” setting to Particle Quality settings that even further reduces complexity of particle effects.
[*] Optimized Blizzard ability particle effects.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Ascendence +2 now raises max health before healing.
[*] Simon’s Beacon +2 no longer triggers when you deal damage to yourself.
[*] Grip of Power +1 will now fallback to overdrawing an ability in the case it has been made free to cast.
[*] Haste +2 now immediately adds an additional attack.
[*] Frozen Heart can now also be used on enemy cards.
[*] Desert Rose trait should properly affect cards that were turned into diamonds after it was applied.
[*] War of the Branches events which disallow Flushes should now properly affect the Mirage trait.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.014
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added the following new Video Options which can be changed to further improve performance.
[*] Animated Lighting: Whether or not adventure table lighting will have its color and intensity animated by small looping videos. Disabling this option can significantly improve performance.
[*] Shadows: Whether or not lights will cast shadows. Disabling this option can increase performance a good amount.
[*] Added “Extremely Low” quality option for “Particle Quality”. This option should be a notable performance increase for more complex particle effects.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Updated Localization.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug which prevented ability search from functioning properly in certain languages.
[*] Fixed bug which prevented Seasoned Adventurer - S achievement from being properly unlocked in certain cases.
[*] Optimized a few visual effects.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.013
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed bug which occurred when casting a single target damaging ability which had its cost temporarily set to free, that would otherwise not be able to be casted.
[*] Inverted healing should now correctly be able to deal lethal damage to an enemy.
[*] Inverted healing is now treated as ability damage dealt by the entity which inverted it.
[*] Several enemy healing Traits which would not trigger at full health now correctly trigger if healing will be inverted.
[*] Fixed bug which prevented Warrior from being properly unlocked if the game crashed before the save file was written.
[*] Optimized several visual effects.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes: 1.012
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed bug which caused enemies with negative HP to infinitely attempt to attack.
[*] Fixed a bug which made events which changed ability card costs not affect flexible card cost abilities in some cases.
[*] Fixed bugs found in the following abilities:
[*] Brunhildr's Kiss (Normal and Legendary versions) incorrectly being restricted to adjacent targets.
[*] Ebb +1 bug which occurred when its cost was reduced.
[*] Ace Shot (All versions) bug which occurred when its cost was reduced.
[/list]
